usage: As a verb, 安裝 means to set up software or hardware, like installing apps or devices.
As a noun, it refers to the process or act of installing something.
You can use 安裝 with objects like 軟件 (software) or 裝置 (device).
It often pairs with 助詞 like 咗 to indicate completion: 安裝咗 means 'installed already'.
The word can describe both physical device installation and digital software installation.
